lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Science and technology (research, breakthrough, device, software, update, artificial intelligence, algorithm, cybersecurity, glitch, prototype).

head: Palavra
Significado
Exemplo
rows: Research shows that exercise improves memory.
Scientists announced a breakthrough in cancer treatment.
Install the update before you restart.
The algorithm suggests videos you might like.
Cybersecurity is a priority for banks.
A small glitch stopped the payments.
The printing press was a great invention.

items: **carry out / do** research, an experiment; **make** a discovery
**install / uninstall / update** software; **back up** your files
**the system is down**; **the app crashes**; **the screen freezes**
"The researches show that..." **Research** é incontável: **Research shows that...**
"My notebook is broke." **Broke** é passado de break. Para o estado: **My laptop is broken.**
"I need to formatar the computer." Em inglês: **reset / wipe** the computer.

acc: Research shows that sleep is important

lessons.title: Passiva avançada
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: passiva com modais, infinitivo e gerúndio passivos, get-passive, causative (have something done) e it is said that.

head: Tipo
Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: The software should be updated every month.
The prototype needs to be tested.
It is said / believed that... / X is said to...
The company is believed to be working on a new chip.

items: Depois de **need to**, **want**, **should**, **must**: *needs to be updated* (passivo) ou *needs updating* (gerúndio, informal).
**Have something done** é quando você manda alguém fazer. *I repaired my laptop* quer dizer que você mesmo consertou.
**Get + particípio** não é para ações planejadas: *My phone got stolen* (azar), mas não *The report got written by the team.*
"The software needs to be update." O certo é **needs to be updated.**
"I have my laptop repair." O certo é **I had my laptop repaired.**
"The files was deleted by mistake." **Files** é plural: **The files were deleted.**
"It is say that the device is dangerous." O certo é **It is said that...**

exercises.prompt: The software should ___ (update) every month.
The data has ___ (steal).

I ___ my laptop ___ (repair) last week.
The software needs to be update.
acc: The software needs to be updated

acc: It is said that the device is dangerous
it's said that the device is dangerous

lessons.title: Inglês prático, explicar um problema técnico
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Explicar um problema técnico.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: It keeps crashing. / The screen freezes when I open the app. / It won't turn on.
It started yesterday, after the update. / It has been happening for a week.
I've already tried restarting it. / I've reinstalled the app, but it didn't help.
Could you walk me through the steps? / Is there a workaround?
So I need to reset the router, is that right?
That fixed it, thanks. / Could you send me those steps by email?

items: "The computer is not working since yesterday." O certo é **The computer hasn't been working since yesterday.**
"It doesn't open." para um programa: **It won't open.** (ou *It doesn't start*).
"I already restarted it" vira mais natural no perfeito: **I've already restarted it.**

exercises.prompt: It keeps ___ every time I open the app.

acc: The computer hasn't been working since yesterday
The computer has not been working since yesterday

exercises.prompt: I already restarted the router.
acc: I have already restarted the router
